title: Impact of Current Smoking in the Tolerance of Bronchoscopy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to study the impact of smoking in the preceding hours before a bronchoscopy on the tolerance of this exam.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* current and regular smoker
* bronchoscopy under local anesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients needing EBUS or fluoroscopy
* intravenous sedative
study_population: Current and regular smokers needing a bronchoscopy as determined by their own physician
